description: RAILISA (Rail Information System and Analyses) is the UIC's online tool for visualising and downloading statistics supplied by railway companies worldwide. It provides indicators for more than 100 railway companies: line and track lengths on the infrastructure network, including high-speed, electrified and single or double track lines, passenger and freight traffic (passenger-kilometres and tonne-kilometres), train movements for infrastructure managers and operators, rolling stock, staff, energy, accidents and financial results. Some indicators go back to 1995, the selector runs to 2025, and the database is updated frequently. The UIC Statistics Platform harmonises the concepts across member companies, and the EU railway statistics regulation drew on UIC collections. Coverage is global for reporting UIC members. Access: the online tool at uic-stats.uic.org lets users select, visualise and download data, with a user guide in PDF; it opened without a login when read, and no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: data depend on what member companies report, and restructuring of railway groups makes comparisons over time harder. It supports rail network and traffic baselines, benchmarking and capacity planning, and complements Eurostat transport statistics catalogued here.
